title: AI large models also jump on the Double 11 bandwagon: Zhipu, MiniMax, Alibaba Cloud, and others collectively launch deep-discount promotions

content_html:
Large model vendors are ushering in the busiest Double 11 shopping festival ever. According to the latest reports, several leading large model vendors, including Zhipu, MiniMax, Qwen Office, Alibaba Cloud, and Qoder, have recently collectively launched a series of unprecedented discount campaigns at the Token Top-up Center of Tmall AI Space Station. Many popular products and Token resource packs are seeing substantial price cuts.

Leading vendors join forces, with steep discounts on multiple products

Judging from the promotional lineups announced by major vendors, this Double 11 event covers mainstream large model services and ecosystem products currently on the market, with impressive specific discounts:

MiniMax: Multiple products under its umbrella are offering discounts together, with three monthly cards available to users at 50% off.

Alibaba Cloud: Launches an exclusive special offer for Token Plan, with two monthly card products starting at 50% off.

Zhipu: Introduces a weekly card product, with a limited-time discount also starting at 50% off.

Qwen Office: Offers a very aggressive first-month discount on its Basic membership monthly card, starting at 70% off.

Qoder: Related monthly card products are also on promotion at as low as 67% off.

Commercial competition in the AI industry intensifies, while barriers to compute power and services continue to fall

Industry analysts point out that large model vendors launching large-scale Token top-up and membership card discount campaigns during the traditional Double 11 shopping festival reflects that the AI industry is accelerating its transition from a single-minded technology arms race toward inclusive, commercial application deployment.

Through periodic deep-discount promotions, major vendors can not only effectively lower the daily usage barrier for developers and ordinary users, but also help further expand their user scale and activity in vertical ecosystems and office scenarios. Users and developers can learn about and participate in these activities through the Token Top-up Center at Tmall AI Space Station.
